android.desc:
Pebbles quietly tracks your recurring tasks and nudges you before they’re due - so small things don’t turn into expensive surprises. 
• Set it once. Rego, filters, refills, bills, tyres - done.
• Get warned early. No more “it’s due today??” energy.
• Keep it simple. A clean list, clear due dates, minimal fuss.
• Offline by default. No reception, no worries! Those reminders will still come your way.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Pebbles – recurring reminders for stuff you forget

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I made an Android (iOS coming soon) app called Pebbles for the recurring chores of being an adult: car registration, filters, smoke alarms, dentist, appliance servicing, pet meds... the list of tiny obligations that somehow become emergency situations.

Idea: turn “boulders” into “pebbles” by reminding you early, consistently, and on a schedule that doesn’t make you hate your phone.

Highlights
• Offline-first (no account required)
• Granular recurring reminders + notification windows
• Built for the “I’ll definitely remember” crowd (that's me)

Link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pebbles.app

If you try it: tell me what’s missing, what’s annoying, and what you’d pay for (if anything) once sync exists.
